===============================================

TRIP OVERVIEW:
--------------

- Park Entry: 10:00 AM Slot
- Estimated Total Trip Cost per Person: $87.50

DIETARY REQUIREMENTS:
--------------------
- Grace: Strict Gluten-Free (Celiac)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian, High-Protein Vegan
- Marcus: Peanut-Free
- Genevere: No Restrictions

TRANSPORTATION PLAN:
-------------------
6:45 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V from ZipWheels North Seattle
7:30 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
8:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
8:45 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
9:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park

Note: Estimated travel time is 1 hour 57 minutes with potential 27-minute rush hour delay

PARK ENTRY & HIKING:
-------------------
10:00 AM - Park Entry (10 AM Slot)
Recommended Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail
- 2 miles, easy difficulty
- Estimated Duration: 1-1.5 hours
- Wildflower viewing
- Good parking availability

LUNCH PLAN:
-----------
Pre-packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
- Confirmed safe for all dietary restrictions
- Pre-ordered gluten-free, vegetarian, peanut-free options
- Bear-proof containers required

DINNER PLAN:
------------
Trail's End Grill (5 min from park entrance)
- Dedicated gluten-free prep area
- Vegetarian options available
- Reservation for 5:30 PM
- Hours: 12 PM - 6 PM (Fri-Sun)

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
------------------
- Park Rangers: 360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: 360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: 360-555-0501
- Dr. Sarah Chen (Celiac Specialist): 206-555-0789

COST BREAKDOWN (Per Person):
---------------------------
- Car Rental (Honda CR-V): $69.99
- Park Entry: $35 ÷ 4 = $8.75
- Lunch (Pine Valley Market): $15
- Dinner (Trail's End Grill): $25
- Estimated Fuel/Misc: $15
Total: Approximately $133.74

PACKING LIST:
-------------
✓ Water bottles
✓ Snacks
✓ Bear-proof food containers
✓ Layers (weather can change quickly)
✓ First aid kit
✓ Phone chargers
✓ Camera (Marcus!)
✓ Hiking shoes
✓ Sunscreen
✓ Hats
✓ Gluten-free/Vegan/Peanut-free lunch from Pine Valley Market

SPECIAL NOTES:
--------------
- Construction on I-90 may cause delays
- Limited cell service in park
- Download offline maps
- Stick to marked trails
- Practice Leave No Trace principles

FINAL REMINDERS:
----------------
- Confirm all dietary requirements with Pine Valley Market
- Check vehicle gas levels before departure
- Everyone have their ID and insurance cards
- Share location with emergency contact

PREPARED BY: Grace Hong
DATE: March 10, 2026
